newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end weaker, Bund spreads widen.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end weaker, Bund spreads widen.

text.p: 1643 GMT - Portuguese bond futures and cash ended weaker after France said it needed more time to consider the stability pact. Spreads against Bunds widened to nearly 80 basis points.
*Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 79 bps vs 76 bps
Portuguese bond futures and cash ended weaker after France said it was not ready to accept a stability pact limiting budget deficits after the launch of the euro in 1999, dealers said.
Spreads widened to 79 basis points from 76 at the close on Friday due to concerns over the timing of the euro, they said.
Tuesday is a public and market holiday, and most dealers do not expect the Bank of Portugal to cut rates on Wednesday.
"What is certain is that we will see a lot of volatility due to concerns over the euro," said a dealer.
A fixed income analyst said: "Spreads could widen against 10-year Bunds beyond 85 basis points (bps)."
